title: General RRatepol package description
text: RRatepol estimates Rate Change (RoC) community composition along temporal sequence. RoC defined dissimilarity consecutive assemblage samples, standardised time elapsed . package primarily designed paleoecological data â€” fossil pollen records â€” can applied community dataset temporal axis. main function, estimate_roc(), accepts community counts sample ages inputs returns time series RoC values. optional second step, detect_peak_points(), identifies statistically significant peaks time series. text: RoC estimated, detect_peak_points() identifies statistically significant increases RoC values â€” intervals rate compositional change unusually rapid. rapid change composition relative abundances can serve marker comparing records interpreting potential drivers assemblage change. Five detection methods available via sel_method argument: Threshold (sel_method = "threshold"): point compared median whole RoC sequence. point significant 95th-quantile RoC value (across randomisations) exceeds global median. Linear trend (sel_method = "trend_linear"): linear model fitted RoC vs.Â age. point significant residual exceeds mean sd_threshold standard deviations (default sd_threshold = 2).
